title: AI-led lending must deliver returns, not just automation, say NBFC leaders
summary: From AI-assisted technology development and automated collections to credit decisions in as little as 15–30 minutes, NBFCs are reporting measurable gains from artificial intelligence. However, executives at the ETBFSI NBFC Leaders’ Retreat 2026 said scaling AI-led lending will depend on cost economics, reliable data, risk controls and human accountability.
